literal_meaning: না চাইতে জল (not asking for water)
figurative_meaning_en: unexpected gain or acquisition without effort
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাছে না চাইতে জল পেয়ে গেলাম, যেন স্বপ্নের মতো।
ব্যবসায় না চাইতে জল এসে গেল, লাভ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: I got water without asking from him, like a dream come true.
The business gained unexpectedly without effort, like unasked water.
note: This idiom reflects the simplicity of rural life where water might be offered unprompted as hospitality.
